attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Colorado corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: // Initialize Colorado filing requirement check; set co_result.has_nexus = false;

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold; result.co_gross_receipts >= result.co_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_dsl: // Physical nexus established - filing required; set co_result.has_nexus = true;
// Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required; set co_result.has_nexus = true;

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; // No nexus - no filing required; set result.co_has_nexus = false; set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Colorado state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Colorado generally conforms to federal IRC with some modifications.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: // Initialize Colorado income adjustments; set co_result.state_additions = 0.0; set co_result.state_subtractions = 0.0;

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Colorado state additions and subtractions; // Calculate Colorado state additions and subtractions; set result.co_state_additions = result.co_us_interest_income; set result.co_state_subtractions = result.co_state_tax_deduction;
action_details.action_dsl: set co_result.state_additions = co_result.us_interest_income; set co_result.state_subtractions = co_result.state_tax_deduction;
action_details.action_postfix: co_result.us_interest_income cvd /co_result.state_additions xdef co_result.state_tax_deduction cvd /co_result.state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no adjustments; // No nexus - no adjustments; set result.co_state_additions = 0.0; set result.co_state_subtractions = 0.0;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Colorado corporate income tax. Applies Colorado flat rate (4.55%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: // Initialize Colorado tax calculation; set co_result.taxable_income = 0.0; set co_result.tax_liability = 0.0;

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Colorado corporate tax (flat rate 4.55%); // Calculate Colorado taxable income and tax; set result.co_taxable_income = (result.co_apportioned_income + result.co_state_additions - result.co_state_subtractions); set result.co_tax_liability = result.co_taxable_income * result.co_corp_tax_rate - result.co_state_credits; set result.co_refund_or_owed = result.co_estimated_payments - result.co_tax_liability;
action_details.action_dsl: if co_result.apportioned_income + co_result.state_additions - co_result.state_subtractions > 0.0 then set co_result.taxable_income = co_result.apportioned_income + co_result.state_additions - co_result.state_subtractions; else set co_result.taxable_income = 0.0; endif if co_result.taxable_income * co_result.corp_tax_rate - co_result.state_credits > 0.0 then set co_result.tax_liability = co_result.taxable_income * co_result.corp_tax_rate - co_result.state_credits; else set co_result.tax_liability = 0.0; endif set co_result.refund_or_owed = co_result.estimated_payments - co_result.tax_liability;
action_details.action_postfix: { co_result.apportioned_income co_result.state_additions f+ co_result.state_subtractions f- cvd /co_result.taxable_income xdef } { 0.0 cvd /co_result.taxable_income xdef } co_result.apportioned_income co_result.state_additions f+ co_result.state_subtractions f- 0.0 f> ifelse { co_result.taxable_income co_result.corp_tax_rate fmul co_result.state_credits f- cvd /co_result.tax_liability xdef } { 0.0 cvd /co_result.tax_liability xdef } co_result.taxable_income co_result.corp_tax_rate fmul co_result.state_credits f- 0.0 f> ifelse co_result.estimated_payments co_result.tax_liability f- cvd /co_result.refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability; // No taxable income - no tax liability; set result.co_taxable_income = 0.0; set result.co_tax_liability = 0.0; set result.co_refund_or_owed = result.co_estimated_payments;
action_details.action_dsl: set co_result.taxable_income = 0.0; set co_result.tax_liability = 0.0; set co_result.refund_or_owed = co_result.estimated_payments;
